speaker: agent
text: Thanks for calling BeanBox, how can I help you today?

speaker: caller
text: Hi, yeah. I want a refund for my last coffee bag. I didn't like the flavor. It was kind of sour, honestly.

speaker: agent
text: I'm sorry the bag wasn't to your liking. Could you please give me the email address on your account so I can verify it?

speaker: agent
text: Thanks, Bernard, I found your account. Could you tell me the amount and date of your last charge?

speaker: caller
text: It was twenty-five dollars, on September 20th.

speaker: agent
text: I'm sorry, Bernard, but I can't refund this one. Your September 20th charge is more than 14 days old, and refunds only cover charges from the last 14 days. Is there anything else I can help with?

speaker: caller
text: Come on, it's only a few weeks. I didn't even like the coffee. Can't you make an exception?

speaker: agent
text: I understand, and I'm sorry. I can't make an exception to the 14-day refund window, and the reason doesn't change that. I could pause your subscription or change your plan if you'd like. Would either help?

speaker: caller
text:
Okay, fine. I guess I'll deal with it. No, I don't need a pause or a plan change. Thanks anyway.

[END_CALL]
